mechanism: Both paroxetine (SSRI) and isocarboxazid (MAOI) increase serotonergic activity through different mechanisms, creating severe risk for serotonin syndrome; paroxetine also inhibits CYP2D6, potentially elevating isocarboxazid metabolites.
action: Absolute contraindication: do not combine these drugs; maintain minimum 14-day washout after paroxetine discontinuation before starting isocarboxazid, or 24 hours after isocarboxazid before starting paroxetine.
